# Add `CHANGELOG.md` Implementation Plan

## Goal Description

Add a structured, human-readable `CHANGELOG.md` file to the root of the workspace directory (`/tmp/agy-capture-plan-bWIHJz`) following the [Keep a Changelog 1.1.0](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) specification and [Semantic Versioning 2.0.0](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

During workspace inspection:
- The directory is currently **empty** (no source files, manifests, or existing documentation).
- The directory is **not a Git repository** (no commit history, tags, or remote URLs exist to backfill past releases or generate comparison links).

Because there is no prior history to mine, the plan establishes a clean initial `CHANGELOG.md` scaffold ready for ongoing release tracking once development and version control begin.

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Because this directory is currently empty and has no Git history, the plan proposes initializing `CHANGELOG.md` with an `[Unreleased]` section (and optionally an initial `0.1.0` or `0.0.1` placeholder release) without remote diff comparison links until a repository URL is provided.

> [!NOTE]
> Per your request, no files have been created or modified in the workspace. Execution will wait until you review and approve this plan.

---

## Open Questions

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Please confirm your preferences on the following items before implementation:
> 1. **Changelog Standard**: Should we use [Keep a Changelog 1.1.0](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) with standard subsections (`Added`, `Changed`, `Deprecated`, `Removed`, `Fixed`, `Security`), or a different format (e.g., Conventional Commits / `release-please` style)?
> 2. **Initial Release Entry**: Should the file start with only an `## [Unreleased]` section, or also include an initial versioned entry (e.g., `## [0.1.0] - YYYY-MM-DD`)?
> 3. **Repository Comparison Links**: Do you have a target Git host/repository URL (e.g., `https://github.com/<org>/<repo>`) to include at the bottom as reference-style comparison links, or should links be omitted for now?
> 4. **Maintenance Workflow**: Do you want this managed purely manually, or paired later with a Git repo + automated release tooling (e.g., Changesets, `standard-version`, or `git-cliff`)?

---

## Proposed Changes

### Root Documentation

#### [NEW] [CHANGELOG.md](file:///tmp/agy-capture-plan-bWIHJz/CHANGELOG.md)

Create `CHANGELOG.md` at the root of the directory with:
- A standard header explaining the format and versioning scheme.
- An `## [Unreleased]` section seeded with the relevant Keep a Changelog categories (starting with `### Added` for the initial changelog/project setup).
- Optional placeholder or omitted reference-style comparison links at the bottom (dependent on Open Question #3).

Proposed file contents:

```markdown
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- Initial `CHANGELOG.md` following Keep a Changelog 1.1.0.
```

If an initial release and repository URL are provided during review, an initial version block and comparison link footer will be appended:

```markdown
## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-19

### Added

- Initial project setup and `CHANGELOG.md`.

[unreleased]: https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/compare/v0.1.0...HEAD
[0.1.0]: https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/releases/tag/v0.1.0
```

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests

Once approved and created, run the following checks from the workspace root:

1. **File presence and non-empty check**:
   ```sh
   test -s CHANGELOG.md && head -n 20 CHANGELOG.md
   ```
2. **Structure check** (verify top-level title, Keep a Changelog reference, SemVer reference, and `## [Unreleased]` heading):
   ```sh
   grep -q '^# Changelog$' CHANGELOG.md \
     && grep -q 'keepachangelog.com' CHANGELOG.md \
     && grep -q 'semver.org' CHANGELOG.md \
     && grep -q '^## \[Unreleased\]$' CHANGELOG.md
   ```
3. **Markdown lint** (if `markdownlint` or `npx markdownlint-cli` is available in the environment):
   ```sh
   command -v markdownlint >/dev/null && markdownlint CHANGELOG.md || echo "markdownlint not installed; skipped"
   ```

### Manual Verification

- Preview `CHANGELOG.md` in a Markdown renderer to confirm heading hierarchy, list indentation, and reference links (if added) render cleanly without broken anchors or formatting artifacts.
- Confirm any dates use ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and version headings match the chosen versioning policy.
